sky cinema premiere.title: Finnegan's Foursome

sky cinema action.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
sky cinema action.desc: The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
sky cinema action.desc: As humanity picks up the pieces after an epic battle, a shadowy group emerges to gain control of history. Meanwhile, a powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
sky cinema action.desc: As war with the Transformers rages on, inventor Cade Yeager forms an unlikely alliance with Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the planet.

sky cinema action.title: Transformers
sky cinema action.desc: Geeky highschooler Sam Witwicky buys his first-ever car, hoping it will improve his chances with Mikaela. Imagine his surprise when his beat-down Camaro transforms into an alien robot called `Bumblebee' and asks for his assistance in a deadly war.

sky cinema family.title: Dog Man
sky cinema family.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

sky cinema family.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
sky cinema family.desc: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

sky cinema family.title: Antz
sky cinema family.desc: Visually exuberant tale about a neurotic ant who struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.

sky cinema family.title: Flushed Away
sky cinema family.desc: A spoiled rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins and make his way back to his plush home.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
sky cinema comedy.desc: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

sky cinema comedy.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
sky cinema comedy.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

sky cinema comedy.title: Shaun of the Dead
sky cinema comedy.desc: Shaun's humdrum existence takes a turn for the interesting when the undead take over London. Leaping into action, Shaun gathers his loved ones in the safest place he knows. Shaun, his mum and her boyfriend, his girlfriend, Liz, and his flatmates Ed and Pete fight off a fate worse than death from the local pub.

sky cinema comedy.title: Hot Fuzz
sky cinema comedy.desc: Hot-shot police officer Nicholas Angel smells foul play when the residents of a sleepy Somerset village start to die in terrible `accidents'. Something's afoot, but can he - and daft local plod Danny Butterman - find out what?

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Pet Sematary
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Dr. Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Katniss Everdeen finds herself in District 13 after she destroys the Games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to launch an assassination attempt on President Snow.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Towering Inferno
sky cinema thriller.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

sky cinema thriller.title: Barron's Cove
sky cinema thriller.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

sky cinema thriller.title: Detroit
sky cinema thriller.desc: As rioting and civil unrest rocks Detroit during the summer of 1967, several policemen begin interrogating guests at the Algiers Motel. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema thriller.title: Black Bag
sky cinema thriller.desc: When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

sky cinema greats.title: Babe
sky cinema greats.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

sky cinema greats.title: The Borrowers
sky cinema greats.desc: Based on the Mary Norton novels about a four-inch-tall family who live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

sky cinema greats.title: Matilda
sky cinema greats.desc: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.

sky cinema greats.title: Casper
sky cinema greats.desc: Stylish, visual effects-laden family fare about a lonely boy-ghost who befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in a fantastic adventure.

sky cinema drama.title: Escape to Victory
sky cinema drama.desc: When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

sky cinema drama.title: Almost Famous: Extended Edition
sky cinema drama.desc: In the 1970s, a 15-year-old boy gets the chance to live out his dream of touring with a band as a rock journalist. The son of a loving but strict single parent, the boy rebels against her distrust of rock music and the surrounding drug culture by writing album reviews which attract sponsorship from a big magazine to tour with a band. Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.

sky cinema drama.title: Philadelphia
sky cinema drama.desc: Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.

sky cinema drama.title: Dunkirk
sky cinema drama.desc: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

sky cinema drama.title: My Girl
sky cinema drama.desc: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.
